courses.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入阻障種子、成長前沿與空洞。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore barrier/seed, growth fronts and voids, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與孔形
stages.description: 針對材料與孔形完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for materials and geometry, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 導體選擇｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對導體選擇，把「Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For conductor selection, turn "Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「導體選擇」的模型：Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for conductor selection: Cu and W differ in resistivity, deposition and thermal mismatch. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare resistance and stress objectives. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare resistance and stress objectives. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最低電阻材料必是每種 TSV 最佳選擇。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming lowest resistivity is always best. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付導體選擇的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for conductor selection, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Compare void shape and height distribution. Misinterpretation to reject: Attributing every void to low plating current. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「潤濕與氣泡」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For wetting and bubbles — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成
低電阻即可免除空洞檢測
被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。
optionsEn: Attributing every void to low plating current
Skipping void inspection after low resistance
Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids.
quiz.explanation: 被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。 比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 因此不能採用「所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成」。
quiz.explanationEn: Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids. Compare void shape and height distribution. Therefore reject: Attributing every void to low plating current.

steps.title: 潤濕與氣泡｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Wetting and bubbles | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對潤濕與氣泡，把「被困氣體阻斷局部沉積，與後期封口空洞有不同位置特徵。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For wetting and bubbles, turn "Trapped gas blocks deposition and differs from late pinch-off voids." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 將「所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare void shape and height distribution. Challenge the hypothesis "Attributing every void to low plating current" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較空洞形狀和分布高度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare void shape and height distribution. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有空洞都由電鍍電流過小造成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Attributing every void to low plating current. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付潤濕與氣泡的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for wetting and bubbles: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 底部優先成長｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對底部優先成長，把「填充前沿需要避免上部提前封口，局部成長速度是關鍵。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For bottom-up growth, turn "Growth fronts must avoid early mouth closure; local rates matter." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「底部優先成長」的模型：填充前沿需要避免上部提前封口，局部成長速度是關鍵。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「重建多個中間截面的前沿演化。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bottom-up growth: Growth fronts must avoid early mouth closure; local rates matter. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Reconstruct fronts from intermediate sections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 重建多個中間截面的前沿演化。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Reconstruct fronts from intermediate sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總沉積量相同即可保證相同填充形貌。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating total deposited mass with fill morphology. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付底部優先成長的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for bottom-up growth, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

stages.title: 金屬填充
stages.description: 針對金屬填充完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for metal filling, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 傳質與圖形｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Transport and pattern | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對傳質與圖形，把「孔密度、流場和深度影響有效反應物供應。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For transport and pattern, turn "Density, flow and depth affect reactant supply." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「傳質與圖形」的模型：孔密度、流場和深度影響有效反應物供應。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按密度區比較空洞與厚度。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for transport and pattern: Density, flow and depth affect reactant supply. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare voids/thickness by density region. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 按密度區比較空洞與厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare voids/thickness by density region. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：流場均勻就代表所有孔內傳質相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating uniform bulk flow with equal in-via transport. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付傳質與圖形的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for transport and pattern, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.titleEn: Overburden and planarization | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對過鍍與平坦化，把「表面金屬留量須足夠平坦化又限制應力與材料耗損。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.objectiveEn: For depth coordinates, turn "TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：統一圖面和量測零點。 將「兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Unify design and metrology zero references. Challenge the hypothesis "Subtracting depths without checking datums" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付深度座標的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for depth coordinates: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 深度座標：機制
knowledge.text: TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。
knowledge.textEn: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 統一圖面和量測零點。 必須排除的錯判：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Unify design and metrology zero references. Misinterpretation to reject: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「深度座標」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For depth coordinates — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 高矽蝕刻速率就是高選擇比
統一圖面和量測零點。
兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準
optionsEn: Equating fast Si removal with high selectivity
Unify design and metrology zero references.
Subtracting depths without checking datums
quiz.explanation: TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 統一圖面和量測零點。 因此不能採用「兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準」。
quiz.explanationEn: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Unify design and metrology zero references. Therefore reject: Subtracting depths without checking datums.

steps.title: 來料 TTV｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對來料 TTV，把「全片厚度分布決定最早和最晚露出區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For incoming ttv, turn "Thickness distribution determines earliest/latest reveal sites." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「來料 TTV」的模型：全片厚度分布決定最早和最晚露出區。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將 TTV 與 TSV 深度地圖配準。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for incoming ttv: Thickness distribution determines earliest/latest reveal sites. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Register TTV and via-depth maps. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將 TTV 與 TSV 深度地圖配準。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Register TTV and via-depth maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均厚度達標即所有 TSV 同步露出。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating mean thickness with simultaneous reveal. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付來料 TTV的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for incoming ttv, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：以局部量測核對全域終點。 將「全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Challenge the hypothesis "Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 以局部量測核對全域終點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付終點感測的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for endpoint sensing: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 終點感測：機制
knowledge.text: 全域訊號可能先反映大面積區而非最晚孔。

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 以局部量測核對全域終點。 必須排除的錯判：全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Misinterpretation to reject: Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「終點感測」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For endpoint sensing — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 看到每個 TSV 即代表露出合格
以局部量測核對全域終點。

Check global endpoints against local measurements.
Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal

steps.title: 突出高度｜機制與設計

steps.instruction: 本步先建立「突出高度」的模型：露出高度分布影響後續介電質覆蓋與接觸。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「量每區高度與支撐面相對關係。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for protrusion height: Protrusion distribution affects later dielectric coverage/contact. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Measure regional height relative to support planes. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.check: 交付突出高度的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.title: 絕緣保存｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對絕緣保存，把「側壁絕緣在露出時仍需隔離金屬與矽。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For insulation preservation, turn "Sidewall insulation must retain metal–Si isolation during reveal." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「絕緣保存」的模型：側壁絕緣在露出時仍需隔離金屬與矽。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照漏電與露出端截面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設最深未露出 TSV 上方還有 3 μm 矽，最快區已露出；若理想矽對保護層選擇比 30，額外移除 3 μm 矽對應 0.1 μm 保護層消耗，仍須另加非均勻與量測餘量。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for insulation preservation: Sidewall insulation must retain metal–Si isolation during reveal. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare leakage and revealed-end sections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: If the latest TSV has 3 μm Si remaining while another is exposed, ideal selectivity 30 implies 0.1 μm protective-layer loss during completion, before nonuniformity and metrology margins. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 對照漏電與露出端截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare leakage and revealed-end sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：金屬露出後不再需要側壁絕緣。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

knowledge.title: 明示假設的量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設最深未露出 TSV 上方還有 3 μm 矽，最快區已露出；若理想矽對保護層選擇比 30，額外移除 3 μm 矽對應 0.1 μm 保護層消耗，仍須另加非均勻與量測餘量。
knowledge.textEn: If the latest TSV has 3 μm Si remaining while another is exposed, ideal selectivity 30 implies 0.1 μm protective-layer loss during completion, before nonuniformity and metrology margins.

quiz.question: 在「絕緣保存」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For insulation preservation — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 平均厚度達標即所有 TSV 同步露出
側壁絕緣在露出時仍需隔離金屬與矽。
金屬露出後不再需要側壁絕緣
optionsEn: Equating mean thickness with simultaneous reveal
Sidewall insulation must retain metal–Si isolation during reveal.
Assuming exposed metal no longer needs sidewall insulation

quiz.explanationEn: Sidewall insulation must retain metal–Si isolation during reveal. Compare leakage and revealed-end sections. Therefore reject: Assuming exposed metal no longer needs sidewall insulation.

courses.title: 玻璃穿孔製作
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入玻璃孔洞、裂紋與金屬化。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore glass vias, cracking and metallization, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 玻璃與孔設計

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for glass and via design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw signal/ground loops and two-port models. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫信號和地孔回路並建雙埠模型。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：低直流電阻即可保證高頻低損耗。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付高頻寄生的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

knowledge.title: 整合放行：機制
knowledge.text: 電連通、裂紋與玻璃處理良率須共同驗證。

單孔強度足以代表所有孔陣列

courses.title: 矽中介層佈線
courses.summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入矽中介層布線、TSV 與回流路徑。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore silicon interposer routing, tsvs and return paths, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接口與架構
stages.description: 針對接口與架構完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interfaces and architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 被動與主動中介層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Passive and active interposers | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對被動與主動中介層，把「是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For passive and active interposers, turn "Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「被動與主動中介層」的模型：是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for passive and active interposers: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark passive wiring and active functions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付被動與主動中介層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for passive and active interposers, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.textEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 必須排除的錯判：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「被動與主動中介層」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For passive and active interposers — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。
所有矽中介層都只是無源連線
線長相同即傳輸行為相同
optionsEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements.
Treating all silicon interposers as passive
Equating length with transmission behavior
quiz.explanation: 是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 因此不能採用「所有矽中介層都只是無源連線」。
quiz.explanationEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Mark passive wiring and active functions. Therefore reject: Treating all silicon interposers as passive.

steps.title: 晶粒邊界分配｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Die shoreline allocation | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒邊界分配，把「I/O 位置須同回流、電源與冗餘共享邊界。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For die shoreline allocation, turn "I/O shares shoreline with returns, power and redundancy." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒邊界分配」的模型：I/O 位置須同回流、電源與冗餘共享邊界。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按實際節距計算可用連接數。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for die shoreline allocation: I/O shares shoreline with returns, power and redundancy. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Count usable connections at actual pitch. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for width and loss: Fine lines ease congestion but raise resistance; geometry and material matter. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. steps.observation: 比較兩種線寬的 RC 和面積。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

steps.failure: 避免：最細線寬總最節能。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for width and loss, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較直線與過孔測試結構。 將「線長相同即傳輸行為相同」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare straight and via test structures. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating length with transmission behavior" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較直線與過孔測試結構。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare straight and via test structures. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：線長相同即傳輸行為相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating length with transmission behavior. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付彎折和過孔的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for bends and vias: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 彎折和過孔：機制
knowledge.text: 局部不連續會造成反射和模式轉換。
knowledge.textEn: Local discontinuities cause reflections/mode conversion.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較直線與過孔測試結構。 必須排除的錯判：線長相同即傳輸行為相同。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare straight and via test structures. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating length with transmission behavior. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「彎折和過孔」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For bends and vias — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 線長相同即傳輸行為相同
導通測試即可覆蓋全部互連失效
比較直線與過孔測試結構。
optionsEn: Equating length with transmission behavior
Using continuity to cover every interconnect failure
Compare straight and via test structures.
quiz.explanation: 局部不連續會造成反射和模式轉換。 比較直線與過孔測試結構。 因此不能採用「線長相同即傳輸行為相同」。

steps.title: TSV 分配｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對TSV 分配，把「訊號、電源與地 TSV 的位置共同决定回路。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For tsv allocation, turn "Signal, power and ground TSV locations jointly define loops." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「TSV 分配」的模型：訊號、電源與地 TSV 的位置共同决定回路。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「建立 TSV 網路與電流密度圖。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for tsv allocation: Signal, power and ground TSV locations jointly define loops. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Build TSV net and current-density maps. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 建立 TSV 網路與電流密度圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Build TSV net and current-density maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：地 TSV 可只按剩餘空間放置。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Placing ground TSVs only in leftover space. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付TSV 分配的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for tsv allocation, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.objective: 針對供電降壓，把「高密度訊號布線不可侵占必要供電截面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For power drop, turn "Dense signal routes must preserve power cross-section." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「供電降壓」的模型：高密度訊號布線不可侵占必要供電截面。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「計算最遠節點 IR drop 和回路電感。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設可用邊長 10 mm、I/O 節距 50 μm、單列配置，理想最多 200 個位置；若每四位置需一個回流地，訊號位置上限約 150，還不含電源和保留區。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for power drop: Dense signal routes must preserve power cross-section. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Calculate far-node IR drop and loop inductance. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: A 10 mm shoreline at 50 μm pitch permits an ideal 200 positions in one row. If one of every four is ground, signals are at most about 150 before power/keep-outs. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.
steps.observation: 計算最遠節點 IR drop 和回路電感。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Calculate far-node IR drop and loop inductance. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：信號 DRC 通過即可忽略供電能力。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring power capacity after signal DRC passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付供電降壓的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for power drop, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 必須排除的錯判：各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating separate simulations as system qualification. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格
optionsEn: Assuming differential signals need no ground reference
Interposer, die and package models need consistent ports/reference planes.
Treating separate simulations as system qualification

quiz.explanationEn: Interposer, die and package models need consistent ports/reference planes. Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Therefore reject: Treating separate simulations as system qualification.

steps.title: 共同簽核｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對共同簽核，把「中介層、晶粒及封裝模型需相同端口與參考面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For co-signoff, turn "Interposer, die and package models need consistent ports/reference planes." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 將「各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating separate simulations as system qualification" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating separate simulations as system qualification. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付共同簽核的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for co-signoff: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

related.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Bump coplanarity, current density and interface reliability. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 熱壓接合
related.why: 共面性與焊料體積決定熱壓接合的接觸分布
related.whyEn: Coplanarity and solder volume determine contact distribution during thermocompression
related.transfer: 共面性與焊料體積決定熱壓接合的接觸分布
related.transferEn: Coplanarity and solder volume determine contact distribution during thermocompression
related.difference: 本課形成凸塊，熱壓課研究受力與接合後界面
related.differenceEn: This course forms bumps; thermocompression studies loading and bonded interfaces
practice: 以「焊墊與凸塊座標」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use pad and bump coordinates to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.
Using "Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
related.why: 兩者皆須連續種子層、圖形電鍍與去種子層
related.whyEn: Both require continuous seed, patterned plating and seed removal
related.transfer: 兩者皆須連續種子層、圖形電鍍與去種子層
related.transferEn: Both require continuous seed, patterned plating and seed removal
related.difference: 凸塊控制高度與頂面，RDL 控制線寬、厚度與跨材料應力
related.differenceEn: Pillars control height and topography; RDL controls width, thickness and cross-material stress
practice: 以「銅微結構」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「晶粒與雜質影響延展、電阻與後續熱循環；室溫電阻正常並不排除脆化界面。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「將電阻、截面與熱處理前後微結構配對，保持樣本位置可追溯。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use copper microstructure to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Grains and impurities affect ductility, resistance and thermal cycling; normal room-temperature resistance does not exclude embrittlement.
Using "Pair resistance, cross-section and pre/post-thermal microstructure with traceable sampling positions.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 先進封裝電鍍原理與應用

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：力—熱—位移耦合與接合後界面。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
related.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Force–temperature–displacement coupling and bonded interfaces. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
related.why: 柱高與焊料帽是接合接觸分布的輸入
related.whyEn: Pillar height and solder caps set the contact distribution
related.transfer: 柱高與焊料帽是接合接觸分布的輸入
related.transferEn: Pillar height and solder caps set the contact distribution
related.difference: 凸塊製造的共面性不等於加熱受壓後共面性
related.differenceEn: Fabricated coplanarity differs from hot loaded coplanarity
practice: 以「接合堆疊剖面」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use bond-stack cross-section to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes.
Using "Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 直接銅對銅接合
related.why: 皆須控制表面、接觸面積與熱負荷
related.whyEn: Both control surfaces, contact area and thermal load
related.transfer: 皆須控制表面、接觸面積與熱負荷
related.transferEn: Both control surfaces, contact area and thermal load
related.difference: 熱壓可含焊料或聚合物，直接銅接合沒有焊料自對位假設
related.differenceEn: TCB may include solder or polymer; direct Cu bonding cannot assume solder self-alignment
practice: 以「位移回授與壓縮」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「量到的 Z 位移含工具、基板與接點變形，不能全部算成焊料壓縮。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「以空載與剛性參考比較回授，再同接合後間隙截面交叉驗證。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use displacement feedback and compression to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Measured Z motion includes tool, substrate and joint compliance; it is not all solder compression.
Using "Use unloaded and rigid references, then cross-check against post-bond gap sections.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 精密接合研究論文入口

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：銅表面形貌、接觸形成與界面電阻。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
related.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Copper topography, contact formation and interface resistance. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 都依賴清潔、平坦度與銅接點重疊
related.whyEn: Both depend on cleanliness, flatness and Cu-pad overlap
related.transfer: 都依賴清潔、平坦度與銅接點重疊
related.transferEn: Both depend on cleanliness, flatness and Cu-pad overlap
related.difference: 直接金屬接合不等於同時存在介電質接合的混合界面
related.differenceEn: Direct metal bonding is not identical to a hybrid metal–dielectric interface
practice: 以「銅與介電界面區分」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use separate cu and dielectric interfaces to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding.
Using "Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
related.why: 皆需銅微結構與電遷移驗證
related.whyEn: Both require Cu microstructure and electromigration verification
related.transfer: 皆需銅微結構與電遷移驗證
related.transferEn: Both require Cu microstructure and electromigration verification
related.difference: 銅柱通常有較大形貌與可選焊料帽，直接接合須另建表面接觸模型
related.differenceEn: Pillars have larger topography and optional solder caps; direct bonding needs its own contact model
practice: 以「真實接觸與塑性」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「粗糙峰先接觸，局部塑性及擴散會改變界面；名義壓力不足以描述接觸演化。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較載入前後形貌、接觸電阻與殘餘印痕，用同幾何對照件。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use real contact and plasticity to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Asperities touch first; local plasticity and diffusion evolve the interface, beyond nominal-pressure descriptions.
Using "Compare pre/post-load topography, resistance and residual impressions using matched geometries.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 精密接合研究論文入口
三維整合與 IC 堆疊
references.titleEn: 3D integration: IC stacking to extend scaling

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：已知良品、局部對位與混合介面。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
related.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Known-good die, local overlay and hybrid interfaces. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 介電質接合與銅重疊的證據可轉移
related.whyEn: Evidence for dielectric bonding and Cu overlap transfers
related.transfer: 介電質接合與銅重疊的證據可轉移
related.transferEn: Evidence for dielectric bonding and Cu overlap transfers
related.difference: 晶粒對晶圓增加切割污染、拾取及逐顆對位，不能照搬全片接合良率
related.differenceEn: D2W adds singulation contamination, pickup and per-die overlay beyond W2W
practice: 以「已知良品置信度」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use known-good-die confidence to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free.
Using "Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置
related.why: 取放座標、旋轉和表面保護直接傳入接合
related.whyEn: Pickup coordinates, rotation and surface protection feed directly into bonding
related.transfer: 取放座標、旋轉和表面保護直接傳入接合
related.transferEn: Pickup coordinates, rotation and surface protection feed directly into bonding
related.difference: 放置精度尚不等於退火後電接點重疊
related.differenceEn: Placement precision is not post-anneal electrical overlay
practice: 以「誤差分解」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「拾取、相機、平台與熱漂移的誤差須分解系統項和隨機項。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use overlay decomposition to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Separate systematic and random pickup, camera, stage and thermal errors.
Using "Use repeat placements and time-series control charts.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 2 μm 接點節距的晶粒對晶圓混合接合展示
references.titleEn: D2W hybrid bonding with 2 μm Cu pad pitch

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：堆疊拓撲、累積誤差與可測性。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
related.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Stack topology, accumulated error and testability. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 共用良品篩選、表面與對位證據
related.whyEn: Shares die screening, surface and overlay evidence
related.transfer: 共用良品篩選、表面與對位證據
related.transferEn: Shares die screening, surface and overlay evidence
related.difference: 晶粒對晶粒處理對象更小且兩側支撐不同
related.differenceEn: D2D uses smaller workpieces with different support on both sides
practice: 以「面向與拓撲」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫每層訊號、電源和背面。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use orientation and topology to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads.
Using "Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理
related.why: 堆疊熱阻和熱源位置直接耦合
related.whyEn: Stack thermal resistance couples directly to heat-source position
related.transfer: 堆疊熱阻和熱源位置直接耦合
related.transferEn: Stack thermal resistance couples directly to heat-source position
related.difference: 本課組裝可行性不取代熱管理的系統邊界
related.differenceEn: Assembly feasibility does not replace system thermal boundaries
practice: 以「逐層對位」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「相對每層對準不保證對共同基準的累積誤差小。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「同時繪相鄰誤差與全堆疊基準誤差。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use layer-by-layer overlay to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Good adjacent-layer overlay need not ensure small error to a common datum.
Using "Plot adjacent-layer and common-datum errors.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 三維整合與 IC 堆疊
references.titleEn: 3D integration: IC stacking to extend scaling

references.title: 精密接合研究論文入口

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：載板支撐、黏著窗口與低損傷解接合。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。

related.difference: 本課還需兼顧可拆解性，研磨課著重材料移除與損傷

用本課的「按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。

related.difference: 晶圓連續片與重組晶粒的局部台階和流動邊界不同
related.differenceEn: Continuous wafers and reconstituted dies have different steps and flow boundaries
practice: 以「熱预算相容性」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「暫時膠需承受加工歷程又保留釋放能力。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較加工前後的剪切、滑移和殘膠。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：薄化幾何、次表面損傷與薄片支撐。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。

related.transferEn: Adhesive and carrier uniformity precede grinding geometry
related.difference: 暫時接合重在支撐釋放，本課分析材料移除與損傷

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Final thickness must reserve later stress-relief and reveal allowances.
Using "Draw a station-by-station thickness waterfall.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 矽穿孔背面露出

比較「透明保護層、背面反射與探頭校正會影響厚度讀值。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「用可追溯標準片與另一方法交叉校核。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use thickness reference to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Transparent protection, backside reflections and probe calibration affect readings.
Using "Cross-check with traceable standards and a second method.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

references.title: 切割、研磨與薄片處理技術
DBG 與 SDBG 加工路徑

related.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：內部改質層、裂紋傳播與薄晶粒強度。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
